name: laporpak-monorepo
description: LaporPak! - Agentic Intelligence Layer for Public Complaint Management

scripts.db:migrate: docker compose run --rm api alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:rollback: docker compose run --rm api alembic downgrade -1
scripts.db:revision: docker compose run --rm api alembic revision --autogenerate
scripts.db:seed: docker compose run --rm api python -m app.db.init_db
scripts.db:init: docker compose run --rm api sh -c "alembic upgrade head && python -m app.db.init_db"

author: LaporPak Team
